summary: Phases 1-4 remain landed green and self-contained (unchanged from the prior dispatch). This dispatch attempted the Phase 5 guard redesign the prior dispatch's blocker called for, and it landed: blockingWorldS4Keyed compares the prospective successor's birth content against the RECORDED keys list (not worlds' live relevant sets), with modalApplyOneS4Keyed/modalStepBranchS4Keyed redefined so both branch bookkeeping and keys bookkeeping are driven by this same keys-aware decision (modalApplyOneS4/blockingWorldS4/modalHintikkaSetS4 untouched, remaining task 506's valid live-set-guarded artifact). The SPECIFIC fact the prior dispatch proved impossible -- modalStepBranchS4_preserves_keysDistinct -- is now proved, as keysUpdate_preserves_keysDistinct, directly from blockingWorldS4Keyed_none_fresh with no live-set indirection. Phase 5 remains BLOCKED, but the blocker narrowed from a structural design gap to a bounded Lean proof-engineering gap: S4LoopInv.keyLowerBd's minting-case equality (relevantSetFinset of a freshly-minted world equals successorBirthContent) is mathematically verified by hand and its reusable groundwork (mint-shape unfolding lemmas, subformula-membership helpers) is landed, but the Finset/Bool/Prop bridging proof itself did not converge within this dispatch's budget and was removed (not committed with a sorry) rather than left broken. Phases 6-7 were not attempted (both depend on Phase 5). Zero sorry, zero new axiom, zero vacuous placeholders throughout; lake build/checkInitImports/lint/lint-style/shake/test all green for this dispatch's changes.

This is successorBirthContent's own design claim (its docstring: 'matches the actual K-minting birth content'), hand-verified true: modalApplyOne's box-neg/diamond-pos minting arms transmit exactly the box-positive/diamond-negative context successorBirthContent filters for.

(2) Landed modalSubfmls_trans_S4/modalUniverseS4_mem_formula (subformula-membership groundwork the witness case needs, given branch-closure hb : ∀ x ∈ b, x ∈ modalUniverseS4 φ₀ plus source membership hsf -- a precondition the original lemma sketch omitted). (3) Attempted the full Finset.ext equality proof via simp-set iteration (Bool.or_eq_true, List.any_cons, List.mem_cons, SignedFormula.mk.injEq, ...); the residual goal shape shifted non-monotonically across attempts (over-application of SignedFormula.mk.injEq to an unrelated Sign × Proposition Atom pair produced spurious conjuncts) and did not converge within budget.
blockers.fix_needed: A continuation should reuse the four landed groundwork lemmas, then prove two small membership-iff helper lemmas (one per filterMap group: box-positive transmission, diamond-negative transmission -- mirroring FmpMeasure.lean's private mem_boxPositivesOf but as a full Iff), compose them into relevantSetFinset_boxNeg_mint/_diamondPos_mint (with the hb/hsf hypotheses this dispatch discovered are required), then keyLowerBd's preservation follows by cases on blockingWorldS4Keyed (blocked = no-op; unblocked = this equality composed with relevantSetFinset_mono for untouched old keys). Comparable in size to the original research report's own '~150-250 line' estimate for this piece.
blockers.prohibited_workarounds_avoided: No sorry, no vacuous placeholder, no weakening of keysDistinct or keyLowerBd. The unfinished equality lemma was removed from the file rather than committed broken or with a sorry.
